risk_confirm.title: Fuel spill & fire hazard
risk_confirm.body: Gasoline is highly flammable. Depressurize only as the manual allows. If the filter is in-tank or access requires dropping a tank, stop and find a nearby shop.

steps.title: Tank additive — measured, not magic
steps.coach_encourage: A quality cleaner can help deposits — it won't fix a dead injector. Look at you — about 71% complete. Keep going.
steps.personalize: Additive pass for your {{make}} at {{mileage}} miles. Reassess drivability by ~{{next_service}} miles.
steps.description: If the manual allows, use a reputable PEA-based cleaner at the listed dose on a low tank, then fill with quality fuel. Skip miracle 'restore 50 HP' claims.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

risk_confirm.body: Cracking a pressurized fuel rail can spray atomized gasoline and cause fire or severe injury. Do not DIY GDI injector/rail service. Find a nearby shop.
